blogs.title: Banana (Mashed) Puree Recipe for Babies
blogs.title_hi: बच्चों के लिए केला (मसला हुआ) प्यूरी रेसिपी
blogs.content:
In our place, we get a banana called Matti Pazham. It is small in size and easy to digest for the baby. You can feed any small variety banana for your baby in their raw form. But nendrapazham which is called as ripe plantain should be steamed.

 

Things to remember:

 

1) The texture of the puree depends upon you, I would recommend you to make the puree smooth.

2) Your baby won't empty the whole bowl all at once, start with few spoons then increase it gradually as days pass by.

3) In my opinion & experience bananas won't cause any constipation in babies.

4) I don’t prefer freezing purees. I make it fresh every day. But if you are busy or find difficult to get time, then freeze it in individual containers and thaw it overnight in the fridge. 

   

How to sterilize baby feeding bowls: 

   

Start by sterilizing the bowls and spoons which you are going to feed your baby. Take the bowl and spoon in a large saucepan, cover it with water and bring them to a boil. Boil it rapidly for 5 mins. Now you can turn the heat off and leave them to stay in the hot water till use. 

 

How to make Banana Puree: 

 

Take a firm fresh and sweet banana. Wash them well.

Peel them, cube them.  

Now take them in a blender along with some water and puree them.  

Pour into a clean bowl and feed your baby.

blogs.title: Pear, Oats And Cardamom Porridge Recipe for Babies
blogs.title_hi: शिशुओं के लिए नाशपाती, जई और इलायची दलिया पकाने की विधि
blogs.content:
I should have posted this recipe right after this one. I have written in detail about spicing your baby's food. In my apple oatmeal recipe, I spiced it with a touch of cinnamon. Now in my pear oatmeal, I added a touch of cardamom and it was yummy.

 

Things to remember:

 

1) I used instant oats since that is the only oats available in my place. If you can get steel-cut oats, then they are highly recommended.

2) You could add any fruits in this porridge that your baby loves.

3) Adding cardamom is optional. You can leave it or simply add any other spices like cinnamon.

4) If you are afraid, whether oats/oatmeal cause constipation in babies. In my opinion and experience, oats/oatmeal won't cause constipation.

5) Puree the oats porridge finely or to the texture, you like to feed your baby.

6) If your pear is too sweet and you find your porridge to be sweet enough. Then don't add any sugar. But Maha likes her food a little on the sweeter side, so I added juts a tsp of sugar.

7) I am not feeding oats daily to maha. I give ragi porridge one day, the next day I feed raw banana powder porridge, then the next day i give her oats porridge. So she doesn’t feel bored with the same food. 

8) I recommend you to start oatmeal on the 6th month of your baby.

 

How to sterilize baby feeding bowls: 

 

Start by sterilizing the bowls and spoons which you are going to feed your baby. Take the bowl and spoon in a large saucepan, cover it with water and bring them to a boil. Boil it rapidly for 5 mins. Now you can turn the heat off and leave them to stay in the hot water till use. 

 

How to make porridge:

 

Ingredients:

 

Instant Oats – 1.5 tablespoon

Pear – 1/2 a big one

Cardamom Powder – 1/4 teaspoon

Water – 1/2 cup or adjust

 

Method: 

 

Start by peeling and chopping 1/2 a pear into small pieces.

Take a clean saucepan, in which you cook your baby's food. Add oats, chopped pear, cardamom and clean water in it.

Put the saucepan on the stove and cook it for 3 to 4 mins on a low flame till the oats are completely cooked.

Now take it off the stove and let it cool a bit. Pour the whole mix in a blender and make it into a smooth puree. 

Pour the porridge on to clean sterilized bowls and feed your baby. You can pour this into a feeding bottle and feed your baby.

blogs.title: Rice And Dal Powder ( Khichdi ) Recipe for Babies
blogs.title_hi: बच्चों के लिए चावल और दाल पाउडर (खिचड़ी) पकाने की विधि
blogs.content:
This is just roasting dal and rice in a tsp of ghee for quite a long time till it is golden and toasted. Now add some roasted cumin and asafoetida and powder them finely. 

 

Things to remember before making this powder:

1) Make sure you roast the rice and dal well before grinding it.

2) Always make small batches, so the powder stays fresh always. 

3) I store the powder in an airtight container in the fridge.

4) This porridge can be given for babies who are above 6 months.  

5) This powder doesn’t cause constipation in babies.

6) The consistency of the porridge which you make totally depends on you. You can make it too runnier and pour it bottles and feed your baby or make it a little thicker and feed your baby using a spoon.

7) If you feed a good bowl of this for your baby. Your baby will sleep peacefully for a good 2 to 3 hours. It is that filling.

8)You can add a touch of salt for taste and drizzle some homemade ghee.

 

How to sterilize baby feeding bowls: 

 

Start by sterilizing the bowls and spoons which you are going to feed your baby. Take the bowl and spoon in a large saucepan, cover it with water and bring them to a boil. Boil it rapidly for 5 mins. Now you can turn the heat off and leave them to stay in the hot water till use. 

 

How to make Rice & Dal Powder:

Ingredients:

Rice – 1 cup

Yellow Split Moong Dal / Pasi Paruppu – 1/4 cup

Masoor Dal – 1/4 cup

Cumin Seeds – 1 teaspoon

Asafoetida / Hing / Kaya Podi – 1/2 teaspoon

Homemade ghee – 1 teaspoon

 

For Making Porridge:

Rice Dal Powder – 2 tablespoon

Nuts Powder – 2 tsp

Water – 3/4 cup

Salt to taste (optional)

Homemade Ghee – 1 tsp

 

 

Method:

 

Wash rice and dal in lots of water till it is completely cleaned. Drain it and dry it.

Heat ghee in a thick bottom Kadai. Add in the washed rice and dal and roast them on medium heat till it is golden. It will take around 20 to 25 mins.

Now remove them to a plate and let it cool.

In the same pan roast cumin and asafoetida for a couple of mins and remove them as well.

Now take everything in a blender and powder them finely.

Place a sieve over a place and sieve this mix. You will get some coarse crumbs, add that back in blender and powder again and sieve it again.

Once everything is done, allow the powder to cool and then store it in an airtight container. 

I store these in the fridge.

When making porridge, I add a couple of tablespoons of this powder and 2 tsp of the nuts powder. I mix them well with 3/4 water and heat it. I cook this on low heat till it is cooked, it will take around 5 mins.

Now remove them from heat and allow it to cool a bit, you can add some salt and some ghee for taste and feed your baby.

blogs.title: Dal Spinach Soup Recipe for Babies
blogs.title_hi: बच्चों के लिए दाल पालक सूप रेसिपी
blogs.content:
Soups are such a healthy way to include veggies and dals and whatever you want to give to your baby. Since it is in liquid form, your baby will love to have it. If your baby has started their one year, then you can add milk in her soups..Will share different ways of making soups in the coming session.

 

Things to remember when making soups:

 

1)Always wash your dals and spinach really well.

2)You can use any spinach of your choice, palak will make a great healthy soup too.

3)You could add any veggies in this, I will share a dal veg soup soon. 

4)You can feed this soup in the evening, this makes a light before dinner meal for your baby.

5)If your baby needs some taste in their food, you can add some salt too.

 

 

How to sterilize baby feeding bowls: 

 

Start by sterilizing the bowls and spoons which you are going to feed your baby. Take the bowl and spoon in a large saucepan, cover it with water and bring them to a boil. Boil it rapidly for 5 mins. Now you can turn the heat off and leave them to stay in the hot water till use. 

 

How to Make Dal & Spinach Soup:

 

Ingredients:

Split Yellow Moong Dal / Pasi Paruppu – 1 tablespoon

Spinach Leaves – 2 handfuls (I used arai keerai)

Garlic – 1 fat clove

Asafoetida / Hing / Kaya Podi – a pinch

Water – 1 cup

 

Method:

 

Wash dal and spinach leave well.

Take all the ingredients in a pressure cooker. Cook it for 5 whistles. Switch off the heat and let the pressure go all by itself. 

Open the cooker, take the dal mix in a blender and make it into a smooth puree, add water if needed.

Pour into serving bowls and feed your baby using a spoon.

blogs.title: Green Gram ( Dal ) Puree Recipe for Babies
blogs.title_hi: शिशुओं के लिए ग्रीन ग्राम (दाल) प्यूरी रेसिपी
blogs.content:
This is my first recipe, I will share a few more variations soon. Since green gram is very healthy for your babies, you can feed this 3 to 4 times a week. I change the dals each day and make sure that her diet gets dals every day.

 

Things to remember:

 

1)The texture of the puree depends upon you, I would recommend you to make the puree smooth.

2)Your baby won't empty the whole bowl all at once, start with few spoons then increase it gradually as days pass by.

3)In my opinion & experience, green gram won't cause any constipation in babies.

4) I don’t prefer freezing purees. I make it fresh every day. 

5)Green Grams are less likely to have any allergenic reactions.

 

How to sterilize baby feeding bowls: 

 

Start by sterilizing the bowls and spoons which you are going to feed your baby. Take the bowl and spoon in a large saucepan, cover it with water and bring them to a boil. Boil it rapidly for 5 mins. Now you can turn the heat off and leave them to stay in the hot water till use. 

 

How to make Green Gram Puree:

Ingredients:

Whole Green Gram / Pachai Payaru – 3 tablespoon

Garlic – 1 fat clove

Cumin Seeds / Jeerakam – 1/2 teaspoon

Water – 1 cup

 

 

Method:

Wash green gram really well. Add it to a pressure cooker along with garlic and cumin seeds. Add in a cup of water.

Cover it and cook for 5 whistles, simmer it for 5 mins. Turn off the heat and let the steam go all by itself.

Now open the cooker and mash it well with a spoon.

Pour into bowls and feed your baby.

blogs.title: Papaya Puree Recipe for Babies
blogs.title_hi: बच्चों के लिए पपीता प्यूरी रेसिपी
blogs.content:
In my opinion, Papaya is one of the super fruit to give babies. It helps to boost digestion and improves it. It has lots of vitamins A, C & E, rich in beta carotene, fiber, and folic acid. But I would never suggest giving papaya in the early stage.

 

Things to remember:

1)The texture of the puree depends upon you, I would recommend you to make the puree smooth.

2)Your baby won't empty the whole bowl all at once, start with few spoons then increase it gradually as days pass by.

3)In my opinion & experience melons won't cause any constipation in babies.

4) I don't prefer freezing purees. I make it fresh every day. But if you are busy or find difficult to get time, then freeze it in individual containers and thaw it overnight in the fridge.

5)When choosing papaya, choose ripe ones.

6)I suggest feeding this to your baby after their 10th month.

  

How to sterilize baby feeding bowls:

Start by sterilizing the bowls and spoons which you are going to feed your baby. Take the bowl and spoon in a large saucepan, cover it with water and bring them to a boil. Boil it rapidly for 5 mins. Now you can turn the heat off and leave them to stay in the hot water till use.

 

How to Make Papaya Puree:

Take some ripe sweet papaya, peel them, deseed them and cube them. Add them to a blender and make into a fine puree. Pour into a feeding bowl and feed your baby.

blogs.title: Vegetable Soup (Cream) Recipe for Babies
blogs.title_hi: बच्चों के लिए वेजिटेबल सूप (क्रीम) रेसिपी
blogs.content:
This is my cream of vegetable soup. I add little cow’s milk in her baby foods. I added some in her soups too. Especially this veg soup taste so good when you add some milk. But if your baby is less than 1 year. You can simply leave it out.

 

Things to remember when making soups:

 

1)Always wash your veggies really well.

2)You can use any veggies of your choice.

3)You can feed this soup in the evening, this makes a light before dinner meal for your baby.

4)If your baby needs some taste in their food, you can add some salt too.

5)If your baby is less than 1 year old, don't add milk in this. Cow’s Milk should be given to babies for more than 1 year.

 

How to sterilize baby feeding bowls: 

Start by sterilizing the bowls and spoons which you are going to feed your baby. Take the bowl and spoon in a large saucepan, cover it with water and bring them to a boil. Boil it rapidly for 5 mins. Now you can turn the heat off and leave them to stay in the hot water till use. 

 

How to Make Cream of Veg Soup:

 

Ingredients:

 

Potatoes – 1/4 of a small one peeled and chopped

Carrots – 1/4 of a small one chopped

Beans – 2 chopped

Cauliflower – 2 small pieces chopped

Garlic – 1 clove

Water – 1/2 cup

Milk – 3 tablespoon boiled (use if your baby is more than 1 year)

 

 

Method:

Take all veggies in a pressure cooker, add in water and garlic. Pressure cook for 3 whistles. Turn off the heat and let the pressure go all by itself. 

Open the cooker and add it in a blender. Puree it finely.

Add in boiled milk and puree again.

Pour into a bowl and feed your baby.

blogs.title: Dal Soup Recipe for Babies
blogs.title_hi: शिशुओं के लिए दाल का सूप पकाने की विधि
blogs.content:
I have shared two versions of this soup. A clear one and a thick one. For younger babies, you can feed dal clear soup. But maha doesn’t like the clear soup. So I puree the whole dal with all the ingredients added and make it thick and creamy. She loves it that way.

 

Things to remember when making soups:

1)Always wash your dal really well.

2)You can use any veggies of your choice in this soup. 

3)You can feed this soup in the evening, this makes a light before dinner meal for your baby.

4)If your baby needs some taste in their food, you can add some salt too.

 

How to sterilize baby feeding bowls: 

Start by sterilizing the bowls and spoons which you are going to feed your baby. Take the bowl and spoon in a large saucepan, cover it with water and bring them to a boil. Boil it rapidly for 5 mins. Now you can turn the heat off and leave them to stay in the hot water till use. 

 

How to Make Dal Soup:

Ingredients:

Toor Dal / Tuvaram paruppu – 2 tablespoon

Turmeric Powder / Manjal Podi – 1/4 teaspoon

Garlic – 1 fat clove peeled

Asafoetida / Hing / Kaya Podi – a pinch

Cumin Seeds / Jeerakam – 1/2 teaspoon

Water – 1 cup

Method:

Wash Toor dal really well. Now take it in a pressure cooker along with all ingredients and cook for 4 whistles.

 

Now turn off the heat and let the steam go all by itself.

Open the cooker.

Now for dal clear soup, you can strain the dal in a sieve. The strained liquid is dal clear soup. You can feed that too babies less than 6 months. Pour it in a sterilized feeding bottle and feed your baby.

For Dal soup, take the strained dal in a mixer and add some of the cooking liquid to it. Puree till smooth. Pour this into bowls and feed your baby.

blogs.title: Guava Puree Recipe for Babies
blogs.title_hi: शिशुओं के लिए अमरूद प्यूरी रेसिपी
blogs.content:
Guava is very good in vitamin C and helps to improve the immune system. This makes a great baby food too.

 

Things to remember:

 

1)The texture of the puree depends upon you, I would recommend you to make the puree smooth.   

2)Your baby won't empty the whole bowl all at once, start with few spoons then increase it gradually as days pass by.

3)In my opinion and experience, guava won't cause any constipation in babies. I feed this puree once a week. 

4) I don’t prefer freezing purees. I make it fresh every day. 

5)Remove the seeds from the guava completely. 

6)Cooking the guava before feeding makes digestion easy.

 

How to sterilize baby feeding bowls:  

Start by sterilizing the bowls and spoons which you are going to feed your baby. Take the bowl and spoon in a large saucepan, cover it with water and bring them to a boil. Boil it rapidly for 5 mins. Now you can turn the heat off and leave them to stay in the hot water till use. 

 

How to make Steamed Mashed Banana:

Take ripe guava. It has to be fresh and ripe. Peel them and cut the cheeks of them.

Use a spoon to scoop the seeds from them.

Now take all the flesh in a saucepan, add a splash of water and cover it and simmer for 5 mins or till it is cooked.

Pierce with a knife to see whether it is cooked. If you go in easily then it is cooked.

Put them in a blender and puree them. You can add some clean water to adjust the consistency.

Pour this into sterilized clean bowls and feed your baby.

blogs.title: Custard Apple (Sitaphal) Milkshake Recipe
blogs.content:
I have never heard about this milkshake until my sister mentioned this. She told me that she feeds her baby this milkshake and it tastes really yummy too. During our last shopping hubby picked a few custard apples which were lying in the fridge. We normally eat them like it, it is such a pain to remove the seeds from the flesh. So when I wanted to make a milkshake out of it, The result was a creamy glassful of a delicious drink. 

 

You can feed this to your baby too, this milkshake can be started after 6 months, but don't add cow’s milk until your baby is 1 year..instead add breast milk or formula milk or simply leave it out.

 

Preparation Time: 5 mins

Makes: 1 glass

 

Ingredients:

Custard Apple / Sitaphal – 1 Ripe

Sugar – 1 tablespoon

Cold Milk – 1 cup

 

Method:

Crack open a custard apple, scoop the flesh from it, take it in a blender, add in 1/4 cup of milk and pulse it a few times this will remove the flesh from the seeds.

Now remove the seeds from the mixer jar.

Add sugar and more milk. Grind till it is frothy.

Pour into a glass and serve immediately.

blogs.title: Apple Sticks with Homemade Peanut Butter Recipe
blogs.title_hi: ऐप्पल स्टिक होममेड पीनट बटर रेसिपी के साथ
blogs.content:
My baby food section is a total hit. I have started giving normal foods. Many of my viewers have been asking me to share some finger food ideas for babies. So I have started this series from today. So keep looking for new food ideas.

Some people may think about peanut allergies, but feeding peanuts to babies below 1 year is not advisable. But you can slowly introduce peanuts after 1 year, but I kind of stayed away from it till now and started now. I don't want to give her whole peanuts, so made this peanut butter and gave her. I made apples as a finger and dipped it in peanut butter and gave her. She liked it.

You can give this to babies above 1.5 years.

 

Preparation Time : 15 mins

Makes : 250 grams

 

Ingredients:

Roasted Whole Peanuts – 250 grams

Powdered Palm Sugar / Jaggery – 3 tablespoon

Salt – 1/4 tsp

Oil – 2 tablespoon

Green Apples, Red Apples

Method:

Take peanuts in a blender, powder them into a powder.

 

Continue blending till oil comes from it, add in jaggery, salt and blend till smooth.

Now add in 1 tablespoon of oil and puree till smooth. Now add in another tablespoon of oil and puree till smooth.

Cut apples into thick slices and cut into finger-like strips. 

Serve with apple sticks.

blogs.title: Mini Potato Paratha Recipe, Finger Food Ideas for Babies
blogs.title_hi: मिनी आलू पराठा रेसिपी, शिशुओं के लिए फिंगर फूड आइडियाज
blogs.content:
Paratha is a great food for babies. Not for little ones, I started feeding paratha when maha was 15 months. I made soft paratha and chapatis, tore it into small pieces. Since it is so soft Kid loves it so much.

There are so many different parathas which you can make for your baby. To make colorful paratha, add some carrot juice or beetroot juice into the wheat flour instead of water. So it is more nutritious for your baby.

 

Preparation Time: 10 mins

Cooking Time: 20 to 25 mins for cooking potato / 1 to 2 mins per paratha

Makes : 3 to 4 small paratha

 

Ingredients:

 

For Dough:

Wheat Flour – 1/2 cup

Salt a pinch

Water as needed

 

For Filling:

Potato – 1 medium size boiled

Salt a pinch

Pepper optional

Ghee for frying paratha

 

Method:

Take dough ingredients in a bowl and make a soft dough. Cover and let it rest.

Mash potato with some salt and pepper. Divide it into two balls.

Take one ball, flatten it out, place a ball in the middle, cover it up, roll it into a thick paratha.

Put it in hot Tawa and cook on both sides till done. Apply ghee as needed.

Tear it into small pieces and feed your baby.

blogs.title: Bread Butter and Jam Recipe, Finger Food Ideas for Babies
blogs.title_hi: ब्रेड बटर और जैम रेसिपी, शिशुओं के लिए फिंगर फूड आइडियाज
blogs.content:
This is a recipe that is not even a recipe, but I just want to share it with you all because it makes great finger food for babies and this is just to give you an idea. So try this out, and this is not only for babies, it makes a great breakfast for adults as well.

 

Preparation Time: 5 mins

Makes: 1 sandwich

 

Ingredients:

Bread as needed

Butter as needed

Jam as needed

 

Method:

Take a bread slice, spread butter generously over it, then spread jam over it. Sandwich it together.

Cut the edges, then cut into slices or strips.

Use a squeezy bottle to make designs over the sandwich.

blogs.title: Healthy Biscuits Recipe for Babies, Teething Biscuits, Finger Food for Babies
blogs.title_hi: बच्चों के लिए स्वस्थ बिस्कुट पकाने की विधि, शुरुआती बिस्कुट, शिशुओं के लिए फिंगर फूड
blogs.content:
Many of you have been asking to share baby teething biscuit recipe, Somedays I like to make some homemade cookies or biscuits for her. For babies, it is not recommended to add any raising agents like baking soda or powder. So it is best to go for a shortbread kind of cookies.

One day I thought of making wheat cookies with ghee. First, I thought of adding jaggery in the cookies, but I was confused that if I need to add jaggery it has to be melted and strained. So I was not sure whether that liquid will make a perfect cookie. So I thought of adding panangkarkandu which is also called rock sugar. I added some ginger powder for flavor and the cookies turned out brilliant.

I hope you will give this a try and not only your baby, you too can enjoy this healthy and tasty one.

 

Preparation Time: 10 mins

Cooking Time: 12 to 14 mins

Makes: 20 Biscuits

 

Ingredients:

 

Wheat Flour / Atta – 1 cup

Rock Sugar / Panangkarkandu – 1/2 cup Powdered

Ghee – 1/4 cup

Dry Ginger Powder / Chukku Podi – 1/2 tsp

Milk – 2 to 3 tablespoon

 

(MY 1 CUP MEASURES 240 ML)

 

Method:

 

Preheat oven to 180 degrees C.

Take ghee and sugar in a bowl. Mix well. Add in milk and mix well till creamy.

Now add in dry ginger powder and mix well.

Add in flour and knead to a dough. Add milk if needed.

Now roll this between two sheets of plastic wrap.

Trim off the edges and cut into strips.

Remove it carefully using a spatula and place on a foil-lined baking sheet.

Bake it for 12 to 14 mins till golden. It will be soft when you take from oven, it will harden as it cools down.

Let it cool completely. Now store this in an airtight container for a week.

blogs.title: Egg Kuzhi Paniyaram Recipe, Finger food Recipe Ideas for Toddlers and Babies
blogs.title_hi: अंडा कुज़ी पनियारम रेसिपी, टॉडलर्स और शिशुओं के लिए फिंगर फूड रेसिपी आइडियाज़
blogs.content:
I made this egg paniyaram a few days back. Before adding the seasoning I too some batter and added only salt and pepper to that and made few paniyaram..Everyone loved it. I thought of sharing it as a separate post so you can find it under finger food for babies..Hope you will give this a try and let me know how it turned out for you..

 

Preparation Time: 10 mins

Cooking Time: 2 to 3 mins per batch

Serves: 2 to 3 

 

Ingredients:

Idli or Dosa Batter – 2 cup

Egg – 2

Oil or Ghee for frying 

Freshly Crushed Black Pepper – to taste

Salt to taste

 

Method:

Take eggs in a blender and blend till it is whipped.

Now take dosa batter in a bowl, add eggs, salt, pepper in it and mix well.

Heat paniyaram pan with some oil. Pour a handful of batter in and cook till golden on both sides on low heat.

Serve.
